name: Mike Waltz
current_role: U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations (since September 2025)
summary: Mike Waltz, a former Green Beret and Florida congressman (2019–2025), was Trump’s first national security adviser in 2025 until he was moved out after adding a journalist to a Signal chat on military strikes; Rubio took over the job. Confirmed as U.N. ambassador in September 2025, he has defended U.S. conduct in the 2026 Iran conflict at the U.N.
